name: 1990 US Census first names
reason: zxcvbn's female_names and male_names lists are the 1990 Census first-name lists; the crate carries no notice for them, and their source asks for a credit (010 research.md §2, amended 2026-11-04)

name: 1990 US Census surnames
reason: zxcvbn's surnames list is the 1990 Census surname list; the crate carries no notice for it, and its source asks for a credit (010 research.md §2, amended 2026-11-04)

name: English Wikipedia word frequencies
reason: zxcvbn's english_wikipedia list, counted mechanically from Wikipedia's text, ships by the exception to 010 FR-015 for word-frequency lists (Feist; 010 research.md §2, amended 2026-11-04)

name: Microsoft WebView2 loader
reason: webview2-com-sys links Microsoft's WebView2LoaderStatic.lib; no dependency tool lists a prebuilt library (010 research.md §3)

name: OpenSSL
reason: the Windows build links vcpkg's static OpenSSL 3 into SQLCipher; the version is read from the build's headers (010 research.md §7)

name: SQLCipher
reason: libsqlite3-sys compiles the SQLCipher source it carries into the program; the crate's license (MIT) doesn't cover it (010 research.md §1, §7)

name: SQLite
reason: SQLCipher's amalgamation holds SQLite, which is in the public domain; its notice is the blessing in the source (010 research.md §1, §7)

name: Ten million passwords
reason: zxcvbn's passwords list is counted from Mark Burnett's public-domain data set; the crate carries no acknowledgement (010 research.md §2, amended 2026-11-04)

name: US television and film word frequencies
reason: zxcvbn's us_tv_and_film list, counted mechanically from Wiktionary's subtitle frequency lists, ships by the exception to 010 FR-015 for word-frequency lists (Feist; 010 research.md §2, amended 2026-11-04)
